scenes.line1: Ever had an outage from a
scenes.say: Ever had an outage because someone forgot to renew a certificate? Let's make sure that never happens again.

scenes.label: Issuers
scenes.sub: Public CAs for internet, internal CAs for company apps.
scenes.say: For public-facing apps, use a public certificate authority. For internal services, your company likely runs its own CA.
Track every certificate: its name, alternate names, who issued it, expiry date, where it's installed, and who owns the renewal.

scenes.title: openssl x509 expiry check
scenes.say: You can check when a certificate expires with the openssl tool. Don't let that date sneak up on you.

scenes.question: What does mTLS require?
scenes.wrong: Only the server presents a cert.
scenes.right: Both client and server present certificates to verify each other.
scenes.say: Here's a common interview trap: in mutual TLS, both sides must present a certificate. Not just the server.
